# infrawrench_cost_canvas_notification (Resource)

A recurring delivery of one cost canvas, rendered as a PDF, to Slack, Teams or email.

Every delivery re-runs the canvas's queries, so each one carries the figures as of the day it is sent. At least one destination is required: a schedule with nowhere to deliver would only ever record failures. The canvas itself decides what the PDF shows; the cadence here only decides how often it is sent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_cost_canvas" "monthly_review" {
  name = "Monthly cost review"
  spec_json = jsonencode({
    version = 1
    blocks = [
      {
        id    = "mtd"
        kind  = "kpi"
        title = "Spend this month"
        metric = {
          type      = "spend"
          dateRange = { kind = "relative", preset = "mtd" }
        }
      },
    ]
  })
}

# The canvas goes to finance as a PDF on the first of every month, with the
# figures as of the morning it is sent.
resource "infrawrench_cost_canvas_notification" "monthly" {
  cost_canvas_id    = infrawrench_cost_canvas.monthly_review.id
  cadence           = "monthly"
  send_day_of_month = 1
  hour              = 8
  timezone          = "Europe/London"
  email_recipients  = ["finance@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cadence` (String) How often the schedule fires. One of `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`.
- `cost_canvas_id` (String) The canvas to send, usually `infrawrench_cost_canvas.x.id`. For a canvas built in the app and not managed here, take the id from the canvas's URL. Changing it replaces the schedule: the route is nested under the canvas, so there is nothing to move.
- `hour` (Number) Local hour (0 to 23) in `timezone` the delivery fires at.
- `timezone` (String) IANA zone, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`. Validated server-side.

### Optional

- `attach_pdf` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. When set, the rendered PDF is attached to each email and uploaded into the Slack message's thread. Teams always receives a summary and a link only, because incoming webhooks cannot carry files.

The Slack upload needs the Slack app installed with the `files:write` scope. An installation that predates it posts the message without the file until the app is reinstalled.
- `email_recipients` (List of String) Email addresses, at most 20. Lowercased server-side.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. A disabled schedule keeps its settings and never fires.
- `send_day` (Number) ISO day of week (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday). Read only when `cadence` is `weekly`.

Computed as well as optional because the server stores a default in the column whatever the cadence is, and reads back null here for any cadence that does not use it.
- `send_day_of_month` (Number) Day of month, 1 to 31. Read only when `cadence` is `monthly`. A day the month doesn't have clamps to its last day, so 31 means month end everywhere.
- `slack_channel_ids` (List of String) Stored Slack channel row ids to post to: the `id` of an `infrawrench_slack_channel`, not a Slack `C…` id.
- `teams_webhook_ids` (List of String) Stored Teams webhook ids to post to, from `infrawrench_msteams_webhook`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned notification id. Import addresses it as `<cost_canvas_id>/<id>`, because the notification's own id is not enough to build its URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A notification hangs off its canvas, so the notification id alone cannot
# build a URL. The address is <cost_canvas_id>/<notification_id>.
terraform import infrawrench_cost_canvas_notification.monthly 6b7c8d9e-0f1a-2b3c-4d5e-6f7a8b9c0d1e/3a4b5c6d-7e8f-9a0b-1c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
```
